title: Insertion Sort
summary: Builds the sorted array one element at a time by inserting each item into its correct position.
usage: Efficient for small or nearly-sorted data; stable and in-place. O(n^2) worst case.

steps.title: Start
steps.explanation: Element 0 is trivially sorted. We insert from index 1 onward.

input.prompt: Does key=1 move to the very front?

steps.title: Insert 1
steps.explanation: 1 is smaller than all; it moves to the front.
